page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn9gc-2x.16xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for compute-intensive workloads. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9A75 processor running at a baseline clock speed of 3.3 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 6.0 GB of RAM per core.
This instance integrates two NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs with a combined total of 144 GB of VRAM. It operates on a KVM hypervisor and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps.

A key architectural tradeoff is the absence of local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached volumes. Additionally, the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of dedicated AMD EPYC cores combined with advanced Blackwell GPU accelerators provides a specialized resource profile for workloads requiring massive parallel processing capabilities without the overhead of local storage maintenance.
Given the hardware configuration, this server is designed for workloads such as large language model training and inference, scientific computing, deep learning, and complex data science jobs.
